_comment: claude-sounds rules. Installed to ~/.claude/hooks/sound-rules.json. Written by /sound-setup but fully hand-editable — it is re-read on every event, so edits apply immediately with no reinstall.

events._comment: event -> slot. A slot is a file: ~/.claude/hooks/sounds/<slot>.mp3, filled by the pack. Set an event to null to stay silent for it. Point it at any slot name you like, including one from another pack or a file you dropped in yourself.

thresholds._comment: Lines written/edited in the turn, deciding which done_* event fires.

custom._comment: Checked in order, BEFORE built-in turn-end classification. First match wins. `match` is an extended regex tested case-insensitively against Claude's final message. `slot` is any file in the sounds dir.
